United States Surtax Order (Steel and Aluminum 2025)

SOR/2025-95

Registered 12 March 2025. Effective 13 March 2025.

A surtax of 25 percent of the value for duty is imposed on goods originating in the United States that fall within the classifications listed in Schedule 2.

Schedule 1 was replaced by Schedule 2 on 1 September 2025.
